title: Vacant Parcels Owned by Public Entities
text:
There are 4,203 unique vacant lots owned by public entities within the City of Dallas
    
      — Dallas Central Appraisal District (2023)
    
  



  
  

  
    
    
      3,642 listed as City of Dallas
    
    
      78 listed as Dallas County
    
    
      225 listed as DART
    
    
      3 listed as Dallas College
    
    
      114 listed as Dallas Independent School District
    
    
      85 listed as Dallas Housing Authority
    
    
      56 listed as owned by a Multiple Owners
    

  







The map below visualizes the vacant land within the boundaries of the City of Dallas currently owned by public agencies such as the City of Dallas, Dallas County, DART, and Dallas ISD, among others using 2023 DCAD Certified rolls.
